items.title: Zcash jumps 20% to landmark $1,000 level as short sellers lose $34 million
items.summary: ZEC briefly traded above $1,020 as a sharp rally forced traders betting against the token out of leveraged positions.

items.title: Bitcoin clears $81,000 as privacy coins lead a broad crypto rally
items.summary: BTC pushed through the level that capped it in late August, while zcash gained 16% and dash 19%.

items.title: IMF confirms El Salvador’s bitcoin growth was funded by private donations, not public money
items.summary: The IMF confirmed that all bitcoin added to official holdings since June 2025 was sourced from private donations, with no public funds used for accumulation.

items.title: South Korea targets February 2027 rollout for full tokenized securities market
items.summary: Financial regulators unveiled a phased roadmap moving traditional capital markets onto distributed ledgers, concluding with onchain stablecoin settlement.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin ETFs take $731 million, their biggest day since January
items.summary: Every fund in the complex rose almost 6% on Thursday and net assets crossed $103 billion for the first time. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for well over half the money.

items.title: OpenAI puts $1 billion behind cyber defense after unveiling AI that can find zero-days
items.summary: The company is subsidizing access to its Daybreak security platform after saying Astra can independently find previously unknown software flaws and turn them into working attacks.

items.title: One full bitcoin now buys a little more than 18 ounces of gold, the most since January
items.summary: Bitcoin is pulling ahead of gold even as both hard assets rally together, driven by fears that governments will inflate away their debt rather than by bond yields.

items.title: Bitcoin back above $81,000 as hike odds fade, Zcash leads with 15% jump
items.summary: Every major token gained on Friday as traders cut bets on a September Federal Reserve rate increase to a coin flip, though most of the majors are barely changed on the week.

items.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
items.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted a provisional charter to the new full-service bank, adding it to the growing mix of crypto-native institutions.

items.title: AMC CEO blasts Robinhood for stock token, putting synthetic shares in spotlight
items.summary: Adam Aron said AMC has no connection to Robinhood’s tokenized shares, reviving questions around how stocks are brought onchain.

items.title: Kalshi US visits soar 1,500% as regulatory pressure mounts
items.summary: Kalshi’s US web traffic climbed more than 1,500% in less than a year, while trading volume grew even faster and legal scrutiny of its sports contracts intensified.

items.title: Trezor says data breach affects another 67K US customers
items.summary: Trezor said an additional 67,000 US users were affected by its shipping provider’s data breach, opening the path to potential phishing attacks and social engineering scams.

items.title: South Korean regulators introduce tokenized securities roadmap
items.summary: South Korea’s financial regulator introduced a three-phase roadmap for the issuance of tokenized assets, as the country prepares to adopt its first tokenized securities framework in February 2027.

items.title: AMC chief criticizes Robinhood’s tokenized stock plan
items.summary: AMC’s CEO criticized Robinhood’s tokenized stock offerings for being unregulated in the US and said he will request an investigation from an external securities counsel.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $731M, highest since January as BTC reclaims $80K
items.summary: US Bitcoin ETFs drew $730.9 million on Thursday as Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000, though CryptoQuant flagged weak fresh demand and a key $83,000 test.

items.title: El Salvador’s post-review Bitcoin accumulation used no public funds: IMF
items.summary: The IMF attributed Bitcoin added since June 2025 to private donations, addressing questions raised after El Salvador reported a $100 million acquisition.

items.title: US, UK launch joint alliance targeting crypto scam centers
items.summary: The agreement includes parallel investigations and information sharing, with US and UK authorities planning a private-sector disruption operation in London in October.

items.title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform
items.summary: The bank is now offering institutional crypto spot trading in the region, bringing BTC and ETH onto the same eFX rails that institutions use to trade dollars and euros.
